subject: AWS listing operator playbook, entitlement gating & field scripts
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: aditya_rao, kimberly_park, marissa_cole, jonas_weber
Cc: marketplace-partner-team@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace readiness: operator playbook + entitlement gating questions

Hi team — thanks again for the quick responses last week. A few items from our intake review that we need you to clarify before catalog approval: 

1) Entitlement gating for trial SKUs: we need an "entitlement matrix" that shows which SKUs are trial vs paid, the trial duration, and how trial-to-paid conversion is enforced (AMI tag, entitlement check at runtime).

2) Pricing footnote guidance: if you plan to use usage-based metering + private offers, include a short footnote explaining the private-offer override behavior and an example calculation for a 100k token/day workload.

3) Field enablement assets: we require a 1-page operator playbook (how to deploy / common troubleshooting), three short field scripts (30–60s talking points) and localized hero images (EN/FR/DE) for the listing.

4) Co-sell tagging: confirm whether you want the co-sell opt-in at launch and which partner contact should be listed for field handoffs.

We generally expect these items by COB Aug 11 to keep the visible listing date of Sep 1. If you need a longer runway, flag it now.

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
AWS Marketplace Partnerships
anna.lopez@amazon.com

-----Original Attachment: none

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Cc: kimberly_park, marissa_cole, jonas_weber
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace readiness: operator playbook + entitlement gating questions

Anna — thanks for the clear checklist. We're aligned on the ask and committing these owners/timeboxes: 

- Entitlement matrix (owner: kimberly_park) — deliverable: entitlement_matrix_v1.xlsx by Aug 7.
- Pricing footnote + example calc (owner: jonas_weber) — deliverable: pricing-footnote.md by Aug 9.
- Operator playbook & field scripts (owner: marissa_cole) — deliverable: field_scripts_v1.docx + 3 hero variants by Aug 11.

Two quick clarifying Qs: 
1) Private-offer display: for private offers that change per-customer effective price, do you want the sample calculation shown in the public product page footnote or only in the procurement snippet? We can do either; preference?
2) Copilot snippets: is it allowed to surface a 1–2 line Copilot usage example in the listing hero (short snippet) or should examples live only in the docs?

I'm attaching a first-pass hero image (redwood_aws_listing_hero_v2.png) and the initial entitlement matrix. We'll iterate quickly.

If this timeline looks tight for the field team, we can request a one-week extension — let me know.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Marketplace & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_aws_listing_hero_v2.png, entitlement_matrix_v1.xlsx

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao, marissa_cole, jonas_weber
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace readiness: operator playbook + entitlement gating questions

Adding the entitlement matrix summary and a short operator-flow for the playbook — draft notes below (will attach full files):

ENTITLEMENT MATRIX (summary):
- SKU: rw-inference-standard -> Trial: 14 days -> Validation: AMI tag + entitlement API check -> Conversion path: customer clicks "upgrade" -> HubSpot deal sync (webhook).
- SKU: rw-inference-highmem -> Trial: none -> Paid only -> AMI-based mapping to sellerid for billing.

PRICING FOOTNOTE (example language candidate):
"Public page rates reflect list metered pricing. Private offers may override effective unit rate for a given customer; example: 100k tokens/day at public list $0.00004/token = $4.00/day; private-offer effective rate $0.00003/token => $3.00/day. Private-offer adjustments are reflected in invoice line items and do not change public list prices."

FIELD SCRIPTS (samples):
- Quick demo opener (30s): "Redwood optimizes prompt throughput with automatic batching and KV caching so you can run real-time features at predictable cost."
- Objection handling (45s): "If latency matters, our Dedicated pools provide reserved throughput and SLA-backed p99s — we can show baseline latency numbers for your workload."
- Migration hook (45s): "We provide a turnkey private deployment package with KMS integration and an on-prem agent for periodic syncs."

NEXT STEPS -> today: marissa to assemble the 1-page operator playbook and three field script variants into field_scripts_v1.docx; I will export final entitlement_matrix_v1.xlsx with mapping to AMI tags by EOD.

Thanks — attaching the current drafts.

Kimberly Park
Product Marketing Manager, Marketplaces
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: entitlement_matrix_v1.xlsx, field_scripts_v1.docx

From: Anna Lopez <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: aditya_rao, kimberly_park, marissa_cole, jonas_weber
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace readiness: operator playbook + entitlement gating questions

Team — this looks good and is sufficient for our intake. A couple of notes: 

- Copilot snippet: allowed as long as it's demonstrative and <120 characters (we'll surface as a single short example).
- Private-offer footnote: please include that exact example language (or equivalent) on the public page; procurement will still receive full invoice-level overrides.
- Co-sell opt-in: Acme procurement has confirmed interest; mark co-sell opt-in = TRUE and list Acme field contact for handoff at launch.

Proposed visible listing date now: 2026-09-06 to allow a one-week buffer. Please update the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-9081 and upload final assets to the Drive folder.

I'll track this on my side — ping me if anything shifts.

Best,
Anna Lopez
AWS Marketplace Partnerships
anna.lopez@amazon.com
